name: official_test250
label_format: <code>-<word>-<FDI>; the FDI tooth number is the LAST token (verified on all 1600 labels: 3 tokens each, 0 FDI outside quadrant 1-4 / tooth 1-8)
naming_rule: Every code is a class named by the ENGLISH name of its Turkish word. Where DENTEX already names the class (Caries, Impacted, Periapical Lesion) that name and id are used; the others are appended to categories_3 after the four DENTEX classes.

roles.finding: a ground-truth annotation of the class named in target_name
roles.negative: the healthy-tooth polygon: not a finding; a disease predicted on this tooth is a false positive

scoring.primary: standard match_multi_findings (exact, FDI-localisation, closeness with its existing proximity credit, e.g. Caries<->Deep Caries 0.75) over all finding classes; nothing is dropped
scoring.family: family_exact_*: Caries and Deep Caries folded into one class (the labels do not separate them)
scoring.lesion: any 'lesion' class name a model can emit, Tufts lesion classes included, is normalised to Periapical Lesion by evaluation/metrics.py normalize_dental_diagnosis
scoring.class_names: predictions written as e.g. 'Root Canal Treatment', 'tooth extraction', 'fractured tooth' are put into the canonical names by evaluation/test250_scoring.py

deep_caries_note: DENTEX id 3 'Deep Caries' stays in the class list (it has 32 of 182 annotations in the official validation set) but no code of these 250 labels is Deep Caries by name; models may still predict it and receive the proximity credit against Caries.

codes.confirmed_by: Reza (2026-11-12: do not mask useful labels)
evidence: step1_check_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12) (d): no DENTEX or Tufts class names a healthy tooth; it is the absence of a finding.
Scored as an explicit negative: a disease predicted on a saglam tooth is a false positive.
The raw labels spell the word 'saglam' (no ğ); 'sağlam' = sound/healthy is language knowledge.
'diş çürüğü' = dental caries (rehberpanda.com Turkish dental glossary: 'Diş çürüğü = dental caries'); equals the DENTEX class (dentex.py:320, official categories_3 id 1).
step1b_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12): density 2.988 per image vs 3.105 (train); tooth-position distance to Caries 0.06 (nearest class).
The labels may include deep caries (no separate code): the proximity credit and family_exact_* cover it.

step1_check_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12) (d): no DENTEX or Tufts class has this name; it is appended to categories_3 as id 5.

codes.confirmed_by: Reza (2026-11-13: check what kanal is in Turkish and use it as its own class)
evidence: Turkish dental glossaries and a Turkish Ministry of Health clinic page give 'kanal tedavisi' = root canal treatment (rehberpanda.com/terminoloji/dental terms; preply.com/en/blog/dental-terms-in-turkish; silifkeadsm.saglik.gov.tr 'Kanal Tedavisi' = 'Root Canal Treatment').
step1_check_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12) (d): no DENTEX or Tufts class has this name; it is appended to categories_3 as id 4.

step1b_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12): its density (0.644 per image) also resembles Deep Caries (0.640 val, 0.820 train); tooth position cannot separate them. Not used for the mapping: the Turkish term names root canal.
'çekim' / 'diş çekimi' = (tooth) extraction (preply.com/en/blog/dental-terms-in-turkish; rehberpanda.com glossary: 'Diş çekimi = tooth extraction').
step1_check_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12) (d): no DENTEX or Tufts class has this name; appended as id 6.

'gömülü diş' = impacted tooth (rehberpanda.com glossary: 'Gömülü diş = impacted tooth'; silifkeadsm.saglik.gov.tr 'Gömülü Diş Çekimi' = 'Impacted Tooth Extraction'); equals the DENTEX class (dentex.py:319, id 0).
step1b_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12): tooth-position distance to Impacted 0.00, share of tooth position 8 = 1.00 (train 1.00), density 0.884 vs 0.857.

codes.confirmed_by: Reza (2026-11-12: do not mask lesion; accept the Tufts lesion classes as well)
evidence: step1_check_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12) (d): 'lesion' is contained in five class names (DENTEX Periapical Lesion; Tufts Periapical, Non-Odontogenic, Pericoronal, Inter-Radicular Lesion).
step1b_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12): nearest class is Periapical Lesion (tooth-position 0.16, FDI 0.26); density 0.300 vs 0.224 (train).
dental_agent/evaluation/metrics.py:92-94 normalises any 'lesion' name to Periapical Lesion, so a model's Tufts lesion classes match this code.

'kırık' = fracture/break; Turkish dental sources use 'kron kırığı' (crown fracture) and 'kök kırığı' / 'kök fraktürü' (root fracture) (openaccess.mku.edu.tr; rehberpanda.com glossary: 'Kök fraktürü = root fracture').
step1_check_output.txt (Reza, 2026-11-12) (d): no DENTEX or Tufts class has this name; appended as id 7.
